INSERT INTO TB_S_RECO_PICK ( SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_BASE_DT, SOURCE_MKT_CD, STK_CD, STK_NM, LISTING_MARKET, WATCH_GROUP_ID, PICK_STATUS, REC_RANK, REC_YN, REC_GRADE, REC_REASON, GOLDEN_YN, MON_UP_YN, MON_CHG_RATE, TREND_STRENGTH, AVG_TRD_VAL_20, REC_ANCHOR_PRICE, WATCH_ANCHOR_PRICE, WATCH_SAVED_AT, POSITION_ID, ENTRY_RULE_CODE, SNAPSHOT_JSON, LAST_TRACK_DT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DATE, MODIFY_DATE ) VALUES ( NVL(#{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'REC_SIGNAL_V110'), TO_DATE(#{sourceBaseDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{sourceMktCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stkCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stkNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{listingMarket,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{watchGroupId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{pickStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'WATCH'), #{recRank,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{recYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), #{recGrade,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{goldenYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{monUpYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{monChgRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trendStrength,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{avgTrdVal20,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{recAnchorPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{watchAnchorPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE, #{positionId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{entryRuleCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{snapshotJson,jdbcType=CLOB},
TO_DATE(#{lastTrackDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL , #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_S_RECO_PICK SET PICK_STATUS = NVL(#{pickStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PICK_STATUS), FIRST_BUY_DATE = TO_DATE(#{firstBuyDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FIRST_BUY_DATE , FIRST_BUY_PRICE = NVL(#{firstBuyPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FIRST_BUY_PRICE), FIRST_BUY_QTY = NVL(#{firstBuyQty,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, FIRST_BUY_QTY), POSITION_ID = NVL(#{positionId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, POSITION_ID), ENTRY_RULE_CODE = NVL(#{entryRuleCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ENTRY_RULE_CODE), MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PICK_ID = #{pickId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
UPDATE TB_S_RECO_PICK SET LAST_TRACK_DT = TO_DATE(#{lastTrackDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PICK_ID = #{pickId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}

MERGE INTO TB_S_RECO_PICK_DAILY T USING ( SELECT #{pickId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS PICK_ID, TO_DATE(#{tradeDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRADE_DT, #{mktCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS MKT_CD, #{stkCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS STK_CD, #{openPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS OPEN_PRICE, #{highPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS HIGH_PRICE, #{lowPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS LOW_PRICE, #{closePrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS CLOSE_PRICE, #{holdDayNoFromRec,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_REC, #{holdDayNoFromWatch,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_WATCH, #{holdDayNoFromBuy,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_BUY, #{returnFromRecPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS RETURN_FROM_REC_PCT, #{returnFromWatchPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS RETURN_FROM_WATCH_PCT, #{returnFromBuyPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS RETURN_FROM_BUY_PCT, #{mfeFromRecPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MFE_FROM_REC_PCT, #{maeFromRecPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MAE_FROM_REC_PCT, #{mfeFromBuyPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MFE_FROM_BUY_PCT, #{maeFromBuyPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MAE_FROM_BUY_PCT, #{upDownFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS UP_DOWN_FLAG, #{tp1HitYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TP1_HIT_YN, #{stopHitYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS STOP_HIT_YN, #{sellSignalCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS SELL_SIGNAL_CODE, #{sellSignalText,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT, NVL(#{priceSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'KIS_DAILY') AS PRICE_SOURCE FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.PICK_ID = S.PICK_ID AND T.TRADE_DT = S.TRADE_DT) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.MKT_CD = S.MKT_CD, T.STK_CD = S.STK_CD, T.OPEN_PRICE = S.OPEN_PRICE, T.HIGH_PRICE = S.HIGH_PRICE, T.LOW_PRICE = S.LOW_PRICE, T.CLOSE_PRICE = S.CLOSE_PRICE, T.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_REC = S.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_REC, T.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_WATCH = S.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_WATCH, T.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_BUY = S.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_BUY, T.RETURN_FROM_REC_PCT = S.RETURN_FROM_REC_PCT, T.RETURN_FROM_WATCH_PCT = S.RETURN_FROM_WATCH_PCT, T.RETURN_FROM_BUY_PCT = S.RETURN_FROM_BUY_PCT, T.MFE_FROM_REC_PCT = S.MFE_FROM_REC_PCT, T.MAE_FROM_REC_PCT = S.MAE_FROM_REC_PCT, T.MFE_FROM_BUY_PCT = S.MFE_FROM_BUY_PCT, T.MAE_FROM_BUY_PCT = S.MAE_FROM_BUY_PCT, T.UP_DOWN_FLAG = S.UP_DOWN_FLAG, T.TP1_HIT_YN = S.TP1_HIT_YN, T.STOP_HIT_YN = S.STOP_HIT_YN, -- ★ sellSignalCode: null 이면 기존 DB 값 유지 (덮어쓰기 방어) T.SELL_SIGNAL_CODE = CASE WHEN S.SELL_SIGNAL_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN S.SELL_SIGNAL_CODE ELSE T.SELL_SIGNAL_CODE END, T.SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT = CASE WHEN S.SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT IS NOT NULL THEN S.SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT ELSE T.SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT END, T.PRICE_SOURCE = S.PRICE_SOURCE, T.MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PICK_ID, TRADE_DT, MKT_CD, STK_CD, OPEN_PRICE, HIGH_PRICE, LOW_PRICE, CLOSE_PRICE, HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_REC, HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_WATCH, HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_BUY, RETURN_FROM_REC_PCT, RETURN_FROM_WATCH_PCT, RETURN_FROM_BUY_PCT, MFE_FROM_REC_PCT, MAE_FROM_REC_PCT, MFE_FROM_BUY_PCT, MAE_FROM_BUY_PCT, UP_DOWN_FLAG, TP1_HIT_YN, STOP_HIT_YN, SELL_SIGNAL_CODE, SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT, PRICE_SOURCE, CREATE_DATE, MODIFY_DATE ) VALUES ( S.PICK_ID, S.TRADE_DT, S.MKT_CD, S.STK_CD, S.OPEN_PRICE, S.HIGH_PRICE, S.LOW_PRICE, S.CLOSE_PRICE, S.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_REC, S.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_WATCH, S.HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_BUY, S.RETURN_FROM_REC_PCT, S.RETURN_FROM_WATCH_PCT, S.RETURN_FROM_BUY_PCT, S.MFE_FROM_REC_PCT, S.MAE_FROM_REC_PCT, S.MFE_FROM_BUY_PCT, S.MAE_FROM_BUY_PCT, S.UP_DOWN_FLAG, S.TP1_HIT_YN, S.STOP_HIT_YN, NVL(S.SELL_SIGNAL_CODE, 'NONE'), S.SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT, S.PRICE_SOURCE, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

MERGE INTO TB_S_RECO_PICK_EVAL T USING ( SELECT #{pickId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS PICK_ID, #{evalType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS EVAL_TYPE, #{holdDays,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS HOLD_DAYS, TO_DATE(#{anchorDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ANCHOR_DATE,
TO_DATE(#{targetDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') NULL AS TARGET_DATE, #{returnPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS RETURN_PCT, #{mfePct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MFE_PCT, #{maePct,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MAE_PCT, #{winYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS WIN_YN, #{tp1HitYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TP1_HIT_YN, #{stopHitYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS STOP_HIT_YN, NVL(#{calcStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING') AS CALC_STATUS FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.PICK_ID = S.PICK_ID AND T.EVAL_TYPE = S.EVAL_TYPE AND T.HOLD_DAYS = S.HOLD_DAYS) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.ANCHOR_DATE = S.ANCHOR_DATE, T.TARGET_DATE = S.TARGET_DATE, T.RETURN_PCT = S.RETURN_PCT, T.MFE_PCT = S.MFE_PCT, T.MAE_PCT = S.MAE_PCT, T.WIN_YN = S.WIN_YN, T.TP1_HIT_YN = S.TP1_HIT_YN, T.STOP_HIT_YN = S.STOP_HIT_YN, T.CALC_STATUS = S.CALC_STATUS, T.MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PICK_ID, EVAL_TYPE, HOLD_DAYS, ANCHOR_DATE, TARGET_DATE, RETURN_PCT, MFE_PCT, MAE_PCT, WIN_YN, TP1_HIT_YN, STOP_HIT_YN, CALC_STATUS, CREATE_DATE, MODIFY_DATE ) VALUES ( S.PICK_ID, S.EVAL_TYPE, S.HOLD_DAYS, S.ANCHOR_DATE, S.TARGET_DATE, S.RETURN_PCT, S.MFE_PCT, S.MAE_PCT, S.WIN_YN, S.TP1_HIT_YN, S.STOP_HIT_YN, S.CALC_STATUS, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PICK_ID AS pickId, SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, TO_CHAR(SOURCE_BASE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sourceBaseDt, SOURCE_MKT_CD AS sourceMktCd, STK_CD AS stkCd, STK_NM AS stkNm, LISTING_MARKET AS listingMarket, WATCH_GROUP_ID AS watchGroupId, PICK_STATUS AS pickStatus, REC_RANK AS recRank, REC_YN AS recYn, REC_GRADE AS recGrade, REC_REASON AS recReason, GOLDEN_YN AS goldenYn, MON_UP_YN AS monUpYn, MON_CHG_RATE AS monChgRate, TREND_STRENGTH AS trendStrength, AVG_TRD_VAL_20 AS avgTrdVal20, REC_ANCHOR_PRICE AS recAnchorPrice, WATCH_ANCHOR_PRICE AS watchAnchorPrice, TO_CHAR(WATCH_SAVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS watchSavedAt, TO_CHAR(FIRST_BUY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS firstBuyDate, FIRST_BUY_PRICE AS firstBuyPrice, FIRST_BUY_QTY AS firstBuyQty, POSITION_ID AS positionId, ENTRY_RULE_CODE AS entryRuleCode, SNAPSHOT_JSON AS snapshotJson, TO_CHAR(LAST_TRACK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lastTrackDt, CREATE_USER AS createUser, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createDate, TO_CHAR(MODIFY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS modifyDate FROM TB_S_RECO_PICK WHERE 1 = 1 AND PICK_ID = TO_NUMBER(#{pickId}) AND POSITION_ID = TO_NUMBER(#{positionId}) ORDER BY PICK_ID DESC

SELECT PICK_ID AS pickId, SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, TO_CHAR(SOURCE_BASE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sourceBaseDt, SOURCE_MKT_CD AS sourceMktCd, STK_CD AS stkCd, STK_NM AS stkNm, LISTING_MARKET AS listingMarket, WATCH_GROUP_ID AS watchGroupId, PICK_STATUS AS pickStatus, REC_RANK AS recRank, REC_YN AS recYn, REC_GRADE AS recGrade, REC_REASON AS recReason, GOLDEN_YN AS goldenYn, MON_UP_YN AS monUpYn, MON_CHG_RATE AS monChgRate, TREND_STRENGTH AS trendStrength, AVG_TRD_VAL_20 AS avgTrdVal20, REC_ANCHOR_PRICE AS recAnchorPrice, WATCH_ANCHOR_PRICE AS watchAnchorPrice, TO_CHAR(WATCH_SAVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS watchSavedAt, TO_CHAR(FIRST_BUY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS firstBuyDate, FIRST_BUY_PRICE AS firstBuyPrice, FIRST_BUY_QTY AS firstBuyQty, POSITION_ID AS positionId, ENTRY_RULE_CODE AS entryRuleCode, TO_CHAR(LAST_TRACK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lastTrackDt, CREATE_USER AS createUser, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createDate, TO_CHAR(MODIFY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS modifyDate FROM TB_S_RECO_PICK WHERE 1 = 1 AND PICK_STATUS = #{pickStatus} AND SOURCE_MKT_CD = #{mktCd} AND WATCH_GROUP_ID = #{watchGroupId} AND STK_CD = #{stkCd} AND SOURCE_BASE_DT = TO_DATE(#{sourceBaseDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND POSITION_ID = TO_NUMBER(#{positionId}) ORDER BY WATCH_SAVED_AT DESC, PICK_ID DESC

SELECT PICK_ID AS pickId, TO_CHAR(SOURCE_BASE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sourceBaseDt, SOURCE_MKT_CD AS sourceMktCd, STK_CD AS stkCd, STK_NM AS stkNm, LISTING_MARKET AS listingMarket, WATCH_GROUP_ID AS watchGroupId, PICK_STATUS AS pickStatus, REC_GRADE AS recGrade, REC_REASON AS recReason, GOLDEN_YN AS goldenYn, MON_UP_YN AS monUpYn, MON_CHG_RATE AS monChgRate, TREND_STRENGTH AS trendStrength, AVG_TRD_VAL_20 AS avgTrdVal20, REC_ANCHOR_PRICE AS recAnchorPrice, WATCH_ANCHOR_PRICE AS watchAnchorPrice, TO_CHAR(WATCH_SAVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS watchSavedAt, TO_CHAR(FIRST_BUY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS firstBuyDate, FIRST_BUY_PRICE AS firstBuyPrice, FIRST_BUY_QTY AS firstBuyQty, POSITION_ID AS positionId, ENTRY_RULE_CODE AS entryRuleCode, TO_CHAR(LAST_TRACK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lastTrackDt FROM TB_S_RECO_PICK WHERE PICK_STATUS IN ('WATCH', 'BOUGHT') AND PICK_ID = TO_NUMBER(#{pickId}) AND SOURCE_MKT_CD = #{mktCd} ORDER BY WATCH_SAVED_AT ASC, PICK_ID ASC

SELECT PICK_ID AS pickId, TO_CHAR(SOURCE_BASE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sourceBaseDt, SOURCE_MKT_CD AS sourceMktCd, STK_CD AS stkCd, STK_NM AS stkNm, LISTING_MARKET AS listingMarket, PICK_STATUS AS pickStatus, REC_GRADE AS recGrade, ENTRY_RULE_CODE AS entryRuleCode FROM TB_S_RECO_PICK WHERE PICK_STATUS IN ('WATCH', 'BOUGHT', 'CLOSED') ORDER BY PICK_ID DESC

SELECT PICK_ID AS pickId, TO_CHAR(TRADE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tradeDt, MKT_CD AS mktCd, STK_CD AS stkCd, OPEN_PRICE AS openPrice, HIGH_PRICE AS highPrice, LOW_PRICE AS lowPrice, CLOSE_PRICE AS closePrice, HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_REC AS holdDayNoFromRec, HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_WATCH AS holdDayNoFromWatch, HOLD_DAY_NO_FROM_BUY AS holdDayNoFromBuy, RETURN_FROM_REC_PCT AS returnFromRecPct, RETURN_FROM_WATCH_PCT AS returnFromWatchPct, RETURN_FROM_BUY_PCT AS returnFromBuyPct, MFE_FROM_REC_PCT AS mfeFromRecPct, MAE_FROM_REC_PCT AS maeFromRecPct, MFE_FROM_BUY_PCT AS mfeFromBuyPct, MAE_FROM_BUY_PCT AS maeFromBuyPct, UP_DOWN_FLAG AS upDownFlag, TP1_HIT_YN AS tp1HitYn, STOP_HIT_YN AS stopHitYn, SELL_SIGNAL_CODE AS sellSignalCode, SELL_SIGNAL_TEXT AS sellSignalText, PRICE_SOURCE AS priceSource FROM TB_S_RECO_PICK_DAILY WHERE 1 = 1 AND PICK_ID = TO_NUMBER(#{pickId}) AND TRADE_DT >= TO_DATE(#{tradeDtFrom}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRADE_DT <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDtTo}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TRADE_DT DESC

SELECT PICK_ID AS pickId, EVAL_TYPE AS evalType, HOLD_DAYS AS holdDays, TO_CHAR(ANCHOR_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS anchorDate, TO_CHAR(TARGET_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS targetDate, RETURN_PCT AS returnPct, MFE_PCT AS mfePct, MAE_PCT AS maePct, WIN_YN AS winYn, TP1_HIT_YN AS tp1HitYn, STOP_HIT_YN AS stopHitYn, CALC_STATUS AS calcStatus FROM TB_S_RECO_PICK_EVAL WHERE 1 = 1 AND PICK_ID = TO_NUMBER(#{pickId}) ORDER BY HOLD_DAYS ASC, EVAL_TYPE ASC

SELECT EVAL_TYPE AS evalType, HOLD_DAYS AS holdDays, SOURCE_MKT_CD AS sourceMktCd, LISTING_MARKET AS listingMarket, REC_GRADE AS recGrade, ENTRY_RULE_CODE AS entryRuleCode, TREND_BUCKET AS trendBucket, MONTH_BUCKET AS monthBucket, SAMPLE_CNT AS sampleCnt, WIN_RATE AS winRate, TP1_RATE AS tp1Rate, STOP_RATE AS stopRate, AVG_RETURN_PCT AS avgReturnPct, AVG_MFE_PCT AS avgMfePct, AVG_MAE_PCT AS avgMaePct FROM VW_S_RECO_PICK_STATS WHERE 1 = 1 AND EVAL_TYPE = #{evalType} AND HOLD_DAYS = TO_NUMBER(#{holdDays}) AND SOURCE_MKT_CD = #{sourceMktCd} AND LISTING_MARKET = #{listingMarket} AND REC_GRADE = #{recGrade} AND ENTRY_RULE_CODE = #{entryRuleCode} AND TREND_BUCKET = #{trendBucket} AND MONTH_BUCKET = #{monthBucket} ORDER BY SAMPLE_CNT DESC, WIN_RATE DESC
